headline: PM Modi Urges SRCC Youth To Build Global Companies
subheadline: Prime Minister defends controversial remarks while making a major pitch for domestic innovation.
summary: Addressing Shri Ram College of Commerce during its centenary celebrations, Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged students to lead global innovation from within India rather than seeking jobs abroad. He also defended his recent 'dimagi Naxal' remarks, framing political backlash as proof his speech resonated.
caption:
🔥 PM Modi Urges SRCC Youth To Build Global Companies

📝 What Happened:
Addressing Shri Ram College of Commerce during its centenary celebrations, Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged students to lead global innovation from within India rather than seeking jobs abroad. He also defended his recent 'dimagi Naxal' remarks, framing political backlash as proof his speech resonated.
